defensives.name: Unending Resolve
defensives.usage_rule: Press before a heavy spike of incoming damage to reduce damage taken by 40% and prevent spell pushback for 8 seconds.

defensives.name: Dark Pact
defensives.usage_rule: Use proactively ahead of a damage event to sacrifice Soul Shards for a large absorb shield; talented choice, so absence is expected if not selected.

defensives.name: Mortal Coil
defensives.usage_rule: Use to instantly heal yourself for a percentage of health while horrifying the target; talented choice on the same row as Howl of Terror.

defensives.name: Healthstone
defensives.usage_rule: Consume when your health drops low to instantly restore a chunk of health; create one before the pull and use it freely on its own cooldown.
